name: Histogram-based Voxel Ambient Occlusion
definition: A histogram-based approach using precomputed intensity distributions (local histograms) for each voxel's neighborhood to modulate ambient occlusion, color bleeding, scattering, and glow effects during rendering.
summary: Histogram-based Voxel Ambient Occlusion approximates ambient occlusion and color bleeding by clustering precomputed local histograms into a 2D texture table, enabling real-time updates with minimal GPU overhead.
